submitted.rationale: All measured EQE values are around 1e-3 % or lower, which is essentially noise. That fits Zn–Sb oxides (for example ZnSb2O6 and Zn7Sb2O12) being wide-gap materials that absorb little at 2.1 eV. Index 5 (Sb 0.37) gave the highest value, 0.00154 %. The Zn-rich side (indices 0 and 5) was slightly positive. The Sb-rich side (13 and 20) was at or below zero.

rejected.reason: EQE is about 0 (negative), in the ZnSb2O6 region
